_comment: An external (non-SJB) season for players who also played for another team. Shown on those players' pages as an extra season + folded into their career, BBref-style; never counts toward SJB's record, leaders or team stats. Keyed by SJB box-score name. Counting-stat totals come from the per-stat tabs (each over its own tracked-game count); shooting + blk/stl come from the box-scores tab (over box_games). Untracked categories (OREB/DREB split, fouls, turnovers, minutes, +/-) are left out and render as '-'.
